page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance within the ecs.c6t instance family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and using the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The server configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance relies entirely on attached network storage, as local disk storage is not included. It also omits dedicated GPU acceleration. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned with the base instance.

Given its high core count relative to system memory, the ecs.c6t.4xlarge offers a focused resource profile for execution environments where processing power is the primary requirement. Typical application fits include continuous integration tasks, batch image or data processing, build farms, high-concurrency web servers, and compute-focused microservices.
